learning: Concise approvals on obviously-correct changes are reliably acted upon.
Specific, file-scoped “issues” get acted on immediately, while broad LGTMs pass cleanly.
Reviews with concrete, context-aware notes are acted on; bare LGTM comments are more likely ignored.
Reviews with concrete, file-scoped findings are acted on, while broad process comments tend to be ignored.
Reviews that include concrete, file-scoped checks and next steps are acted on more than generic LGTM/concerns.
Reviews that raise specific, actionable defects tied to concrete probes are acted on more than broad or generic comments.
Specific, file-scoped suggestions are acted on more than blanket LGTMs.
Concrete, reproducible defect reports in probe scripts are acted on; broad or speculative suggestions tend to be ignored.
Reviews that pinpoint a concrete failure mode (crash/incorrect metric) with a minimal fix are adopted more often than broad performance or docstring-alignment notes.
Reviews that flag concrete crash risks or correctness gaps get acted on; broad or descriptive notes are more often ignored.
Concrete, reproducible defect reports (crashes, logic invariants, mismatched counters) are acted on; abstract or non-failing observations tend to be ignored.
